newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TDK opens $10 million plant in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: TDK opens $10 million plant in Hungary.

text.p: The Japanese electronics company TDK opened its first factory in East Central Europe in Retsag, north Hungary, on Wednesday.

Hungarian business news agency MTI-Econews said the 5,000 square-metre factory, which will initally produce three million transformers and 100 tonnes of ferrite cores a month, represented an investment of 1.2 billion yen ($10.7 million), of which 25 percent came from Hungarian central funding.
TDK's Hungarian unit, TDK Elektronics Hungary Kft, said it planned to double its output of transformers and to increase its monthly output of ferrite cores to 150 tonnes by the end of 1997.
At the opening ceremony Industry and Trade Minister Szabolcs Fazakas said TDK planned to increase the European-made proportion of TDK products sold in Europe to 50 percent from 10 percent
